Based on the research: ear tugging with night crying in a toddler commonly signals an ear infection (otitis media), especially if it follows a cold — pain is often worse lying down/at night. Red flags for urgent/ER care include: fluid/pus/blood draining from the ear, high fever, redness or swelling behind/around the ear, stiff neck, severe pain, or a child who seems very unwell/hard to wake. Otherwise, watchful waiting with pain relief and a routine doctor visit if it doesn't improve in 1-2 days is standard guidance.
